currentProjects.title: DVT Detection Sleeve
description: Post surgery patients are at elevated risk for deep vein thrombosis (DVT) which occurs when a thrombus (blood clot) develops in the veins
This project aims to develop a wearable sleeve that detects blood clots by tracking symptoms and alerts healthcare practitioners upon detection
Identified circuit design necessary to create tetrapolar impedance in order to identify blood clots
Split into three subteams: generator circuit, notch filter, band pass filter
Sleeve design in process, discussing materials and how to keep sleeve secure

currentProjects.title: CTS Smart Brace
description: Wearable designed to assist individuals with carpal tunnel syndrome by tracking wrist and finger movement and delivering heat/cold therapy for symptom relief.
Using 3D printing and CAD design to prototype a custom ergonomic and comfortable wearable band, ensuring both functionality, optimal sensor placement and user comfort.
Real-time feedback, therapy guidance, and clinician-integrated progress tracking
Configured design of sensors and heating placement
Finalized materials (dual layered cotton and nylon glove), silicon rubber for insulation
Determined mechanism of heat flow and grip strength
Met with Lauren Conner, OT (Occupational Therapist) at Team Rehabilitation Physical Therapy

currentProjects.title: Tremor Glove
description: The tremor glove is designed to be a therapeutic tracker for hand tremors, which can be so severe that tasks like eating, grooming, and dressing become difficult
Since tremors are a sign of many different conditions, they are often misdiagnosed and difficult to treat
Using motion and EMG sensors, the device could classify tremors based on intensity, frequency, and circumstance
This data can help doctors more accurately diagnose a patient's condition and prescribe medication or therapy
The glove could also have mechanical components that dampen tremors, providing patients with more stability and autonomy

currentProjects.title: MEND
description: Developing a hat-like device with a built-in TENS (Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation) unit that uses dry electrodes to help relieve migraines

More than 1 billion people experience migraines worldwide, and college students are one of the most prone populations due to their high exposure to triggers like stress, irregular sleep, and elevated screen time
Designed to be worn regularly without bringing unwanted attention to students, reducing the effects of migraines so they can continue their activities and avoid academic obstacles

pastProjects.title: Grip Assist Glove (2024-2026)
description: A sensor-based motorized glove was developed to assist individuals with neurodegenerative or muscular disorders that impair grip strength and hand control
By integrating EMG and flex sensors with a mechanical pulley-motor system, the glove detects user intent and provides personalized grip assistance
The final product will aim to prioritize affordability, user-friendliness, and portability to increase accessibility beyond research settings
Refined motor design, transitioning from stepper motor to servo for light weight and space efficient alternative
Pivoted from use of EMG sensors (commercial availability not sensitive enough) to force sensors on finger tips
Incorporated asynchronous programming for flex sensor and motor software
Designing custom servo reel mount in CAD

pastProjects.title: EMG-Integrated Controller for Muscular Dystrophy Rehabilitation (2024-2025)
description: Gamifies rehabilitation for children affected with muscular dystrophic diseases like cerebral palsy and Duchenne's

Supports the treatment of children affected with muscular dystrophic diseases like cerebral palsy and Duchenne's by increasing their adherence to their rehabilitation protocol via gamifying the treatment
A Raspberry Pi Pico W was used to leverage its WiFi capabilities and small size to send EMG data to an offsite at Amazon Web Services (AWS) database
A WebSocket API integration request was set up on a React server to allow users to use movement as input for an Angry Birds-like game

pastProjects.title: fNIR TBI Detection (2024-2025)
description: Developed software capable of detecting various types of TBIs across different fNIR platforms

Using a Random Forest ML algorithm, analyzed key physiological constraints such as mean oxygenated blood levels by performing an analysis on specific data features and contrasting hemoglobin levels in healthy and unhealthy individuals
By integrating machine learning (ML), the software automates injury assessment, enabling early detection by providing accurate and real-time prognosis on the sidelines

pastProjects.title: PTSD-Activated Nightmare Detecting Apparatus for Service Dogs [PANDAS] (2020-2021)
description: PANDAS strives to aid veterans who suffer from PTSD nightmares by helping train service dogs to recognize night terrors
A biometric monitor detects disrupted sleep in veterans and send signals to provide haptic feedback to a service dog's collar or vest
Once the service dog receives the haptic feedback, they can wake up and comfort the veteran

pastProjects.title: Hydra-Check (2020-2021)
description: Hydra-Check is designed to provide a means for the testing and the diagnosis of dehydration

A stamp-like device applies downwards pressure to a patient's fingernail and lift up whilst a constant light source in combination with a light sensor measures the amount of time it takes for the light intensity to return to normal
As the stamp pulses up and down, the data is plotted on a monitor for the physician to analyze.

pastProjects.title: Walker Project Tri-Wheels (2020-2021)
description: The walker project tri-wheels work to provide a greater range of mobility for individuals who use the BuddyRoamer walker
The multipurpose tri-wheel design allows users to go through sharp elevation changes, such as 6" curbs, which helps eliminate the need for finding ramps or elevators
The tri-wheel also features a set of omni-wheels, which allow for omni-directional movement without the need to turn and reposition alignment prior to lateral progression

pastProjects.title: Smart Sleeve (2019-2020)
description: The smart sleeve is designed to aid in the physical therapy and rehabilitation of patients
The electrical stimulation feature is designed to aid in muscle regrowth, promote muscle regeneration, and to stimulate pain relief for the user
Next, Peltier units are for hot and cold therapy to relax the arm, and finally, the sleeve includes vibration from motors for bone density therapy

pastProjects.title: TMAP (2019-2020)
description: The transmetatarsal foot amputation is common in patients with diabetic neuropathy, ulcers, and peripheral artery disease
This prosthetic is designed to take into account gait and balance, and provide a safer, more comfortable way of walking
It also allows the patient to regain their normal gait and balance, as well as increase limb health post-amputation
Springs act like tendons to distribute weight and sensors record biometric data that is then stored in a mobile app for physician and physical therapist use

pastProjects.title: Verti-Fix (2018-2019)
description: Verti-Fix is a device designed to aid GPs and ER doctors diagnose and correct Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

Even though BPPV is a common condition (more than 200,000 cases per year), GPs and ER doctors will not diagnose it because they need to perform the Dix-Hallpike maneuver on the patient, and if performed incorrectly, could make things worse for the patient

This device helps doctors perform the Dix-Hallpike by guiding them through the proper steps and angles required with the use of a headband, neck brace for the patient, and a small screen for the doctor
It also checks the eyes for nystagmus to diagnose BPPV. Once diagnosed, the doctor will use our device to perform the Epley maneuver to correct the vertigo

pastProjects.title: Ambient Sound Bracelet (2017-2018)
description: The ambient sound bracelet is usable by the hard-of-hearing population
The device may be used to obtain a visual and/or vibratory representation of the local sound environment on the user's wrist
The device will notify the wearer to significant changes in the local auditory environment

pastProjects.title: ExoMIND Glove (2016-2017)
description: The ExoMIND Glove is a stroke rehabilitation device used to generate biofeedback for physical therapists and patients
The ExoMind Glove is a wearable device equipped with 7 accelerometers that are used to quantify forearm, wrist, and finger angles
Additionally, an EMG with conductive fabric electrodes is secured into the sleeve of the device to monitor muscle activity

The glove houses an Arduino 101 which runs an interactive program to prompt the user through motions in order to gauge the range of motion and detect muscle activity which can be used by the physical therapist

pastProjects.title: The Smart Sock (2015-2016)
description: The smart sock is a smart compression stocking for monitoring chronic venous insufficiency

The Smart Sock consists of a novel and non-invasive method of monitoring and treating CVI in the legs that provides convenient, objective and continuous measurements of relative fluid distribution levels and blood flow using bioimpedance spectroscopy (BIS) and reflective red and infrared pulse oximetry.
